u_wind_ms.description: Eastward component of wind (u) in m/s — real ERA5

v_wind_ms.description: Northward component of wind (v) in m/s — real ERA5

specific_humidity_kgkg.description: Specific humidity q in kg/kg — real ERA5

wind_speed_ms.description: Wind speed magnitude sqrt(u²+v²) in m/s

vector_divergence.description: Real ∂u/∂x + ∂v/∂y in s⁻¹ — true vector divergence (not scalar proxy)
vector_divergence.method: centred finite differences on ERA5 u,v components
vector_divergence.improvement_over_proxy: Previous physics loss used scalar wind magnitude only. This is real vector divergence from ERA5 u and v components.

moisture_flux_convergence.method: -∇·(q·V) using ERA5 specific humidity q and u,v wind components
moisture_flux_convergence.improvement_over_proxy: Previous MFC used -div(scalar_wind)*precip (no humidity). This is real -∇·(q·V) with ERA5 specific humidity q.
